should: make the ACs of spec-1933 testable

change AC-2 in the design of spec-1933

evals.query: /sdd-clarify spec-2001 when context.md does not exist
expected_behavior: Stops at Requires and points at /sdd-scan
Does not survey the modules itself

evals.query: /sdd-clarify spec-2002 on a tier: fast story
expected_behavior: Stops and points at /sdd-route to raise the tier

evals.query: /sdd-clarify spec-2003 where five unknowns are about product scope
expected_behavior: Escalates the three with the highest impact and resolves the rest at low confidence
Warns that the item's scope may not be ready
